task: Retained independent Spruce lane and shared D05 native repair

findings.observed: OID4VCI exchange happens before the Add to Wallet save button. Single matching OID4VP credential skips selection; consent controls are Approve and Cancel. Both successful submission and cancellation navigate to wallet Home; the result URL is not used for an automatic Chrome return.
The previous cancel template did not issue a credential after wallet reset, so a clean wallet could not reach its required consent Cancel action.

The native wallet exchanges automatically on handoff, before its save screen. The repaired driver waits for the exact native offer_expires_at, observes the holder-scoped application HTTP200 response with EXPIRED/OFFER_EXPIRED before handoff, then requires the native expired error. The canonical inline offer has no public offer-reference GET; no HTTP410 claim is made.

Pinned native Rust implements VCI credential exchange and signed JWT VC presentation for DCQL with direct_post/direct_post.jwt. This source fact is not a live interoperability or per-run credential-format claim.
The Showcase trustedDids list is empty. The dedicated retained contract makes no independent wallet issuer-allowlist claim; service login results remain required.
